title: Last night's dinner
instructions: Can dün akşam pişirdiği yemeği anlatıyor. Ne olduğunu ve sonucu takip et.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Last night, I cooked dinner for my girlfriend for the first time.

script.speaker: can
script.text: I wanted to make something special, so I tried a new fish recipe.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Unfortunately, I left the fish in the oven for too long, and it burned.

script.speaker: can
script.text: In the end, we ordered a pizza and laughed about it.

script.speaker: can
script.text: Next time, I'm going to cook something easier!

questions.prompt: Who did Can cook dinner for?
questions.feedback: Kız arkadaşı için ilk kez yemek yaptı.
questions.evidence: I cooked dinner for my girlfriend for the first time.

questions.feedback: Balığı fırında çok uzun bıraktı ve yandı.

questions.prompt: What did they eat in the end?
questions.evidence: In the end, we ordered a pizza
